notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Lords of the Realm III, 15% off!
notes.content:
Lords of the Realm III is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

When it comes to medieval real-time strategy, Lords of the Realm III flies the flag high. Whether it's maneuvering troops on the battlefield, negotiating trade and alliances, or overseeing armies across the lands, RTS fans will find plenty here to enjoy.

Check out the entire Lords of the Realm Complete bundle to get Lords of the Realm I, II, III, and Lords of Magic!

*Offer ends December 10 at 10AM Pacific Time
